findings.deficiency: isMinimalModeEnabled compiles to a constant false in the Turbopack server bundle. Reproduced three ways with MINIMAL_MODE=true set (pnpm dev, next dev direct, .env.local entry); worker process env verified present via NODE_OPTIONS preload. deficiencies: LIVE_OK gate fails deterministically 3/3 runs: tests/minimal-mode/live-wire.pg.test.ts exits 1 on unhandled terminating connection due to administrator command from the app-side cached persistence pool during afterAll teardown of the scratch DB. Both assertions pass but the suite never exits 0 so the gate cannot pass. Runtime: with MINIMAL_MODE=true exported, anon POST /api/chat returns 200 SSE not the typed 403; the guard is compiled to an unconditional return. Diff: 23/25 postcondition rows deviate, signature pins claim explicit return types the handlers never had (before-state POST(req: NextRequest) unannotated), violating PIN-FROM-OUTLINE re-pin duty.

slices.expectation: Every model spending route in the matrix adopts requirePermissionIfMinimalMode as the first statement. Flag off restores today's behavior exactly. Flag on denies without permission via the typed 403 before any model call.
